title: Medieval paintings with UFO-like objects in the sky
summary: Michael Shermer tells of Medieval paintings with UFO-like objects in the sky, about Middle Ages at Europe, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you look at these medieval paintings with the thing in the sky that looks sort of like a UFO, whatever.

plain: Michael Shermer, a researcher known as a skeptic, mentions on Jesse Michels's podcast the medieval paintings that show something in the sky that looks a bit like a UFO. He brings this up in connection with writers such as Jacques Vallee and Jeffrey Kripal, who look at old art and stories as possible records of the same kind of phenomenon people report today.
